modePolicy: Each assistant must identify mode first. Codex updates local only and waits for user push plus stated green GitHub Actions before continuing. ChatGPT uses verified patch ZIPs for local application unless explicitly instructed otherwise.
neverGuessPolicy: Never guess when creating, fixing, reviewing, packaging, or reporting updates. Verify before claiming success; if something cannot be verified, state that clearly.
suggestionPolicy: All approved architectural or project suggestions become implementation requirements unless explicitly deferred or rejected.
referenceDataPolicy: All WCC data, WCC-labeled data, WSGSERVE-related data, imported archives, website data, and community/tool data are reference-only unless the user explicitly approves a reviewed import or reconciliation update.
importedDataRetirementPolicy: ImportedDatabases may be retired from normal project work only after all needed source data has been decoded, imported, recreated as Reforged-native Data, verified by reports, and explicitly approved for cleanup.
